user.description: Pick the spa's BWF-200 module. Its advertised name is not known yet; it is usually the strongest unknown device near the spa. Close the SmarTouch app first, a BLE peripheral typically accepts only one connection.

init.title: Protocol parameters
init.description: Leave UUIDs empty to stay in discovery mode (subscribe to every notifying characteristic and log raw frames). Fill these in from captures; see docs/REVERSE_ENGINEERING.md.

data.segment_order: Segment bit order, bit0 upward (e.g. abcdefg.)
data.setpoint_window: Seconds the set point stays shown after a temp press
data.temp_unit: Temperature unit shown by the spa

error.invalid_segment_order: Must contain each of a-g once; '.' for decimal point, 'x' for unused

send_raw.name: Send raw bytes
send_raw.description: Write raw bytes to a GATT characteristic (reverse engineering).
